sections.text:
CORE SKILLS
 Key Skills - Product Ownership & Product Strategy | SAFe Agile | Scrum | Product Roadmap | Program Increment (PI) Planning | Business Analysis | Requirement Management | Epic, User Story Creation & Acceptance Criteria | Product Backlog and Refinement | Product Demo | Stakeholder and Executive Management | Cross-Functional Team Leadership
 Domain Expertise - Wholesale Banking | Retail Banking | Payments - Cross-Border Payments, Real-Time
Payments (RTP), ACH & Wire Payments | ISO 20022 Migration & Transformation - SWIFT MT/MX Messaging | Clearing & Settlement Processes | Fintech
 Delivery & Transformation - End to End Product Delivery | UAT Coordination and Sign-off | Change Management | Workflow Automation | Data Analysis and Reporting | KPI & Performance Metrics
 Tools, Technology & Products - JIRA | Confluence | MS Visio | MS Office Suite | Generative AI | Agentic AI |
API Integration | SQL and Database | ERP | CRM | FINNONE | VMS | ODYSSEY | RET
CORE COMPETENCY
 Extensive experience in defining product roadmaps, managing end-to-end product lifecycles, and driving
large-scale transformation programs aligned with business goal and objectives.
 Skilled in translating complex business and regulatory requirements into scalable solutions while collaborating
with cross-functional stakeholders, technology teams, compliance, operations, and executive leadership.
 Develop deep understanding of business needs by market trends, data analysis and process mapping.
 Strong knowledge of SWIFT ISO 20022 standards, payment message transformation, interoperability
between MT and MX formats, and payment processing workflows across global banking networks.
 Demonstrated success in leading Regulatory Reporting and Compliance applications, including Regulatory Event Tracking (RET) platforms, ensuring compliance with global regulatory requirements, governance frameworks, audit controls, and risk management standards.
 Experienced in SAFe Agile Product Management, backlog refinement, roadmap planning, requirements management, stakeholder engagement, UAT oversight, and delivery of high-impact banking products that enhance operational efficiency, regulatory compliance, customer experience, and business value across global financial institutions.
